$comment: Pre-existing duplicate CREATE TABLE definitions, pinned to the exact set of files that define each table. Each entry is a defect to be reconciled per ADR-0006, not an approved pattern. A NEW table collision, or a NEW file defining an already-colliding table, fails CI. Shrink this file; never grow it. Standing exceptions (documented in ledger C-8/C-10/C-11): entries whose only rival is a dead root-lineage 0010 file — their canonical DDL lives in db/migrations/20260725_* and ADR-0006 retirement of the dead files removes the entries.
$note_on_the_2026_09_10_jump: READ THIS BEFORE COMPARING THIS FILE TO AN OLDER COPY. The count went 34 -> 60 -> 27 on 2026-09-10, and the middle number is the honest one. The 34 -> 60 step added no definition: the guard was fixed. Its CREATE TABLE pattern required a bare word after the optional IF NOT EXISTS, so a leading double quote failed the match outright — and drizzle-kit generate quotes everything. migrations/0000_sweet_joseph.sql, the drizzle baseline, holds 297 CREATE TABLE statements, sits in the root migrations/ tree that install-fresh’s overlay walks, and was counted by this guard as creating NOTHING. Distinct tables seen went 1150 -> 1416. Proved by making it fail: with the old pattern, and a probe file adding a QUOTED second definition of q_submissions, the guard scanned 586 files and reported "34 defined more than once" and a green tick. The 60 -> 27 step is real work: WO-1 stage 2 archived 18 files that no applier runs (see db/migrations/_legacy/README.md, 2026-09-10 section), then amended migrations/0012_project_charter_timeline.sql and migrations/20260524_c2c_blockers.sql in place. EVERY REMAINING ENTRY IS CLASSIFIED in $reasons below — parked, blocked, not-a-defect, or named work. There is no "unreviewed" category here; an entry without a reason is the thing that field exists to prevent. The shrink rule holds from 27. 12 are cortex.* and cannot shrink until WO-14 decides; one (c2c_template_specs) is not a defect at all. 27 -> 15, later on 2026-09-10: WO-14 Route B retired the twelve cortex.* entries. Not a guard change and not an amendment: 073_cortex_prime_unified_brain.sql (on no applier) and 079_gcc_unified_functions_views.sql (whole) were archived to db/migrations/_legacy/, so each of the twelve tables now has exactly one non-archived creator - 074, 077 or 078's, unchanged. The README section there has the evidence; the product decision is at the top of docs/work-orders/WO-14-cortex-prime-is-broken-and-mounted.md. The shrink rule holds from 15.

$reasons.c2c_template_specs: NOT A DEFECT. Verified byte-identical modulo comments: migrations/20260716_template_doc_types.sql repeats 20260531’s CREATE TABLE, same 15 columns, same PK, same CHECK, same constraint name, same three indexes — as a deliberate guard so its ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN doc_types applies on a preview branch that predates the base table. Its own header says so. There is no rival shape and none can arise. The REAL finding here is a reachability gap, not a duplicate: c2c_template_specs has no drizzle definition and neither file is in C2C_MIGRATION_FILES, so doc_types reaches no populated database — WO-15 finding 5. Left in this baseline because the guard cannot distinguish an identical guard from a rival; do not "fix" it by deleting the guard.
$reasons.compliance_tracking: CORRECTED 2026-09-10 after the live diff. This entry previously said "hand-written DDL competing with the drizzle baseline ... needs a column-level diff". The diff was done, and it changed the premise. migrations/0000_sweet_joseph.sql IS INERT ON THE NORMAL PATH — proven, not assumed. It contains ZERO "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS": all 297 statements are unguarded `CREATE TABLE "quoted"`. Its first one, at line 4, creates activity_feed, which drizzle-kit push has already created at install-fresh STEP 2. install-fresh wraps each overlay file in a single BEGIN/COMMIT and rolls the whole file back on error (install-fresh.mjs:1093-1097), so 0000 raises 42P07 on its first statement and contributes NOTHING. Corroborated: vault.evidence_citations, which 0000 creates, is absent from a database built from empty. So 0000 is not the rival that matters. It stays in this baseline because it is real, non-archived text on an applier's scan path that WOULD execute if push ever failed to create the table first — and install-fresh.mjs:786-805 documents exactly that hazard, a push that aborts mid-loop and still exits 0. THE REAL DIVERGENCE for this table is db/migrations/20260402_cmc_runtime_ddl_to_migration.sql (C2C_MIGRATION_FILES index 30, so deploy-migrate) versus the pushed shape. They share almost nothing: the file declares id uuid, project_id, guideline, requirement, status, evidence, justification, mitigation, due_date, completed_date — NONE of which are live — while live has id integer, product_id, agency_id, compliance_status, compliance_score, last/next_assessment_date, requirements, findings, remediation_actions, metadata. Its CREATE is IF NOT EXISTS, so it wins on any database where the table is absent. TWO LIVE BREAKAGES CONFIRMED BY EXECUTION, both recorded in WO-15. server/routes/c2c/context-intelligence.ts:791 selects framework, last_audit_date, next_audit_date, capa_count and owner — columns that exist under NEITHER shape and are added by no migration anywhere — raising 42703, which its catch block at :801 swallows into an empty array. And server/api/cmc/projectRoutes.ts:148,451,477 uses a SECOND rival pgTable at shared/cmc-schema.ts:177 that models the uuid shape and is not in the push graph, so every one of those endpoints 500s on column "project_id" does not exist.
$reasons.contradiction_consequence_log: LIVE DIFF DONE 2026-09-10, and the divergence is far wider than the single column name the earlier note implied. db/migrations/20260323_assumption_decision_contradiction.sql is on deploy-migrate (index 42) and migrations/20260524_contradiction_engine_schema.sql on install-fresh's overlay (#47) — and install-fresh NEVER runs the 20260323 file while deploy-migrate NEVER runs the 20260524 one. Neither table family is in the drizzle push surface (no pgTable for any contradiction_* table exists in shared/). The live tables were created by 20260524. Proof: zero CHECK constraints exist live where 20260323 declares 14; every timestamp is `timestamp` not `timestamptz`; truth_hierarchy_level is text where 20260323 says integer NOT NULL CHECK BETWEEN 1 AND 7; and the FK is named contradiction_consequence_log_finding_id_fkey (raw-SQL convention). Across the family the two shapes differ by 14 CHECK constraints, one column TYPE change (integer vs text), six nullability flips, five default changes, and a timestamptz/timestamp split on every timestamp column. contradiction_decision_links does not exist at all under 20260323 — 20260524 is its only creator anywhere. THE ONE COLUMN-NAME SPLIT IS LIVE BREAKAGE. contradiction_consequence_log names its free-text column execution_notes in 20260323 and notes in 20260524. Server code writes BOTH: four INSERT sites in contradiction-consequence-service.ts use `notes`, four in contradiction-resolution-orchestrator.ts use `execution_notes`. Whichever shape a database has, four of the nine writes raise 42703 — and all nine sit inside catch blocks that discard the error, four with no logging at all. Demonstrated against both shapes. Recorded as WO-15 finding 7. The earlier note said the refuted rename "would raise 42703 on a fresh install". The refutation stands — install-fresh.mjs:1093-1097 wraps each overlay file in one transaction, so an error anywhere in 20260524 would roll back all four contradiction tables — but the direction was imprecise: renaming in 20260323 would not touch the overlay at all, since deploy-migrate is the only applier that runs it. The exposure is a rename applied to 20260524.

$reasons.core.programs: WO-15 FINDING 1 — and this entry was the source of two claims in that finding that a full reproduction has since REFUTED. Corrected here 2026-09-10. Still true: db/migrations/000_gcc_bootstrap_core.sql (9 columns) is on install-fresh step 6 and CI's psql loop; db/migrations/044b_gcc_lumen_schema_prerequisite.sql (7 columns, no metadata, no created_by, status nullable) is on DEPLOY-MIGRATE at index 11; step 6 is the only non-fatal step, so a missing psql leaves 044b to create the 7-column table. WRONG #1: this entry said 069_gcc_multitenant_rls_expansion.sql, which adds org_id, is "on no applier". It carries the _gcc_ infix, so it is on the SAME applier as 000 — install-fresh step 6, sort index 33, after 044b. Applying the step-6 loop to a reproduced 7-column database restored org_id, programs_org_idx and programs_org_fk (43 applied, 0 failed). What is permanently lost is metadata, created_by and status NOT NULL, which only 000's CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supplies. The narrower true claim: nothing on the DEPLOY-ONLY path ever adds org_id. WRONG #2: this entry said the failure "reports as success" via install-fresh. install-fresh prints "❌ Install INCOMPLETE — not reporting success." and exits 1. The success report comes from deploy-migrate, which then exits 0 with "safe to roll services" on the database install-fresh just refused to bless — so a deploy-migrate preflight assertion, not an install-fresh change, is what closes the loop. TWO CONSEQUENCES WORSE THAN THE ROUTE DEFECT, both omitted before and both reproduced: core.programs ships with RLS DISABLED and zero policies, because 20260801_uuid_tenant_isolation_nonpublic.sql skips a declared table whose tenant column is missing (one uncounted NOTICE in a 500-line log, no effect on exit status) — a genuinely cross-tenant-readable table; and core.get_program_org_id, the resolver every vault.documents RLS policy authorizes through, applies green and then raises 42703 at first execution. Do NOT remove this entry to shrink the count: removing it fails ci.yml:91 while both CREATEs remain.

$reasons.submission_orchestrator_dependencies: CORRECTED 2026-09-10 — MY PREVIOUS REASON HERE WAS WRONG. It said "the overlay copy wins on a fresh install and the port wins on a populated one". The overlay copy does not win: drizzle-kit push runs at install-fresh STEP 2 (install-fresh.mjs:752) and the overlay at step 3 (:955), so push creates these tables and migrations/0018_submission_orchestrator.sql:17 is a no-op. Only its indexes, its seed INSERT, its function and its trigger take effect. The live shape matches shared/schema/submissions.ts, not either .sql file — the FK names are drizzle's, truncated at 63 bytes. AND THE LIVE SHAPE IS BROKEN IN A WAY NEITHER FILE IS. Push omits created_at and updated_at, which both files declare. But 0018 also installs trigger trg_orchestrator_runs_updated_at, whose function body assigns NEW.updated_at. So every UPDATE on submission_orchestrator_runs raises 42703 "record \"new\" has no field \"updated_at\"" — demonstrated in a rolled-back transaction on the live database, and succeeding on the port shape in a scratch database. persistRun (server/services/submission-package-orchestrator.ts:1014) uses ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO UPDATE, which every step-write and every resume takes, and 42703 is in its SCHEMA_SHAPE_ERROR_CODES so it re-throws to the route. Net: on a freshly provisioned environment a run can be created but never advanced or completed. Recorded as WO-15 finding 6. Also unported: migrations/20260629_orchestrator_region_check_alignment.sql widens the region CHECK to 13 values and is on neither the port nor C2C_MIGRATION_FILES, while the route accepts all 13.
